IS_EMAIL: Email must be a valid email address
IS_STRING: This field must be a string
IS_ARRAY: This field must be an array
IS_INT: This field must be an integer
IS_UUID: This field must be a valid UUID
IS_ENUM: This field contains an unsupported value
MIN_LENGTH_USERNAME: Username must be at least 3 characters
INVALID_USERNAME_FORMAT: Username can only contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores
MIN_LENGTH_PASSWORD: Password must be at least 8 characters
INVALID_TOKEN_LENGTH: Token must be between 32 and 512 characters
MAX_LENGTH_NAME: Name must not exceed the allowed length
MAX_LENGTH_DESCRIPTION: Description must not exceed the allowed length
MAX_LENGTH_BODY: Body must not exceed the allowed length
MAX_LENGTH_SEARCH_KEYWORD: Search keyword must not exceed 100 characters
NEW_PASSWORD_SAME_AS_CURRENT: New password must be different from the current password
IS_BOOLEAN: This field must be a boolean
INVALID_BOOLEAN_STRING: This field must be exactly "true" or "false"
INVALID_SLUG_FORMAT: Slug can only contain lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens between words
INVALID_PRICE_VND: This field must be a digit-only VND amount within the allowed range
MIN_LENGTH_RECIPIENT_NAME: Recipient name must not be empty
MAX_LENGTH_RECIPIENT_NAME: Recipient name must not exceed the allowed length
INVALID_PHONE_FORMAT: Phone must contain only digits, with an optional leading +
MIN_LENGTH_PHONE: Phone must be at least 8 characters
MAX_LENGTH_ADDRESS: Address must not exceed the allowed length
MAX_LENGTH_CUSTOMER_NOTE: Customer note must not exceed the allowed length
INVALID_ORDER_REJECTION_REASON: reason is required (non-blank, max 500 characters) when status is REJECTED, and must not be sent for other statuses
INVALID_SUGGESTION_REVIEW_REASON: reason is required (non-blank, max 500 characters) when status is REJECTED, and must not be sent for APPROVED
